industry.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement stated. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: A now, A prior at industry level and Logistics A, so the market is buying cyclical transport; Danske (18 Oct) sees heavy trucks 'in the early phase of a new cyclical upturn' on US freight shipments and rates, but that is the vehicle makers (O.16), not the carriers here, and the same note reports 'a sudden change of sentiment in a quality name' in logistics and warns that most cyclical exposure sits 'more or less at all-time highs' with 'cost inflation emerging'. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): a cyclical, freight-exposed industry is not what a risk-off regime pays for over twelve months; leadership and regime offset. Seven of the 149 Pool stocks are Logistics names with strong top-down readings (Kuehne + Nagel, Maersk, Wallenius Wilhelmsen), which the Neutral lets through on merit. Counter-case for higher: two readings at A two months apart; for lower: the cost-inflation warning.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement stated. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: A now, B prior: the market is buying freight, and seven of the 149 Pool stocks are here with strong top-down readings (Kuehne + Nagel, Maersk, Wallenius Wilhelmsen, Dampskibsselskabet NORDEN). Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): a cyclical, freight-exposed group is not what a confirmed risk-off pays for over twelve months, and Danske (18 Oct) reports 'a sudden change of sentiment in a quality name' in logistics alongside its warning on cyclicals at all-time highs with cost inflation emerging. Offset; the Neutral lets the names through on merit. Counter-case for higher: two readings at A or B two months apart, and the trucking upturn Danske sees; for lower: freight is the first casualty if the growth data turn.

geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the Swiss index is among those Goldman (19 Oct) names as rallying alongside non-AI and low-beta exposures, which is the rotation this row was set on; the Swiss National Bank was not re-read this week, so last week's 'not hiking' stands. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case unchanged: the franc takes 2 to 3 points a year off a Swiss exporter's reported profit (Sonova memo), and five of the Swiss Pool names are semiconductor names inside an Underweight sector. Back to C if the SNB joins the hikers or the franc reverses.
